# Wayfair

> > Wayfair is a leading online retailer for home goods and furniture, offering supplier partnership programs and enterprise infrastructure for ecommerce operations.

Wayfair provides a comprehensive supplier platform for merchants to sell furniture and home goods through their marketplace. The platform includes supply chain services like CastleGate fulfillment and enterprise-grade authentication and administration tools.

## Key Topics

- Wayfair marketplace
- Supplier platform
- CastleGate fulfillment
- Home goods and furniture
- Ecommerce partnerships
- Supply chain services
- Online retail operations
- Okta authentication
- Admin portal access
- OneDrive for Business integration
- Merchant selling tools

## Supplier Platform

- [Sell with Wayfair](https://sell.wayfair.com/): Supplier platform for selling home goods and furniture on Wayfair

## Administration & Authentication

- [Wayfair Production - Sign In](https://admin.wayfair.com/): Admin portal sign-in using Okta authentication
